en: Colorized vintage street scene showing a busy outdoor terrace of a building labeled 'Hotel Café Restaurant' on the façade. Numerous people sit at tables under an awning, bicycles are parked in front, and some carts or early carriages are visible on a tree-lined square or road. Red-roofed houses and tall trees line the background. In the sky area on the left is printed text identifying the location as 'Berg en Dal' and 'Hotel Café Restaurant Hamer'.
